name: commonplace
description: A knowledge vault Claude reads and keeps for any folder of notes: graph-indexed vault tools, private domains that stay sealed, connections to what you already wrote surfaced under answers, and [[note]] links in replies that are checked against the vault.

ambientConnections.title: Ambient vault connections
ambientConnections.description: Surface a one-line pointer beneath an answer when it genuinely connects to a note you have already written, with Read it / Not for me (Not for me never surfaces that note again; each press is saved in the vault as a label for eval:judge). Costs one small model call per rate-limited turn, after the answer is on screen.

vaultLinks.title: Vault links in replies
vaultLinks.description: Draw [[links]] in Claude's replies as links to the note, and flag any that is not in your vault, was cited without being read, or is superseded or contested. Drawing only; no model call.

linkTriage.title: Verdict card for pasted links
linkTriage.description: When you paste a link and Claude reads it, end the answer with a card saying whether your vault already has it, it extends or contests a note, or it is new, with Ingest / Later / Skip. One fork of the conversation per link read.

primeContext.title: Prime tasks with a vault note
primeContext.description: Before a task starts, show the model one pointer to the note your vault most clearly holds about it (judged by a small model; most prompts get nothing). Off until its precision gate passes on your vault: run commonplace eval:prime.

showBand.title: Vault status band
showBand.description: Show a one-line receipt above the prompt when the vault was consulted, a private domain is open, or surfacing has stopped. Cards with buttons follow their own switches.
